newsitem.title: GREECE: Drachma hits new year low versus ecu in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Drachma hits new year low versus ecu in late trade.

text.p: The drachma hit a fresh low of 311.75 for the year against the ecu in late trading on Wednesday.
"A level of 313.50/00 for ecu/drachma is attainable in the short-run," said a dealer at NatWest, Athens. "Mark/drachma can test 161 over the same time span."
But other dealers said ecu/drachma might have peaked for the year at these levels.
"Short-covering and the $-and ecu-linked government loans that expire in the next few days have a lot to do with the weakening of the drachma," said a forex trader at a foreign bank.
"My opinion is that ecu/drachma reached a peak for 1997."
Ecu/drachma was trading around 311.60/70 and mark/drachma at 159.70/80 at 1320 GMT.
Ecu/drachma settled at 311.20, a new year high, and mark/drachma at 159.480 at the fixing on Wednesday, with Bank of Greece sticking to its hands-off approach.

"The market will drive ecu/drachma higher in the absence of central bank intervention as some players seek to close out positions ,while others open long ecu, short drachma speculative positions," said a forex dealer at another foreign bank.

Barclays said in its May international financial report that the drachma would slide by about 1.0 percent against the ecu in 1997, the same as in 1996. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
